title: eval-harness: add CI hook for prompt-set regression checks and quality gating
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Adds a CI hook that runs prompt-set regression checks and fails builds on quality-gate violations. Backwards compatible with existing eval fixtures.
description: Motivation: Prevent regressions in prompt-sets and surfaced eval metrics from shipping unnoticed. This PR adds a lightweight CI hook that runs the eval-harness prompt regression checks on changed prompt-sets and evaluates a small representative quality gate before allowing merges. Changeset: 1) ci/hooks/prompt_regression_check.py - main hook which loads changed prompt-sets, runs eval jobs via local harness runner, computes metrics and compares against per-prompt-set baselines; 2) ci/workflows/eval-harness.yml - workflow to call hook on PRs and scheduled runs; 3) eval-harness/tests/test_prompt_regression.py - unit tests for stability and edge cases; 4) docs/eval/quality-gates.md - guidance on gate thresholds and how to update baselines. Testing: unit tests included and ran in CI, end-to-end gated runs executed in staging cluster; observed flaky generation in one seed which we addressed by increasing sampling stability and adding a deterministic fallback for baseline refresh. Rollout plan: behind feature flag EVAL_PROMPT_GATES=false by default; enable for core repositories and opt-in for large monorepo teams for two weeks before turning on as blocking. Related: ENG-2045 implements baseline storage format; SUP-4821 is a customer incident that motivated faster detection. Checklist: - [x] Add hook and workflow - [x] Add unit tests - [x] Add docs - [x] Feature-flag gating - [x] QA runs in staging

ci_log_summary: Initial run: failed (one flaky generation test). Reran after fix: all checks passed. Coverage unchanged (+0.2%).

notes: This PR intentionally keeps baseline updates manual via a 'refresh-baselines' script; automated baseline bumps will be considered in a follow-up to avoid silent regressions.
testing_instructions: To run locally: python ci/hooks/prompt_regression_check.py --changed-files <list> --staging-config; unit tests: pytest eval-harness/tests/test_prompt_regression.py
